title: Michael Jordan's Basketball Hall of Fame Enshrinement Speech
summary: Michael Jordan's 2009 Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame enshrinement speech, in which he thanks and also airs grievances about people who doubted him. It is known for his stories of using slights as motivation.
why: HN refers to it as a source for Jordan's motivation-from-slights anecdotes and his cut-from-the-team story.

quote.text: His hall of fame speech is filled w/ anecdotes about him turning slights into motivation
